description.value: Ferris' Burger & Oyster Bar has occupied the same corner on Yates Street in downtown Victoria since February 4, 1991, built on fresh-shucked Baynes Sound oysters sourced from the same waters for nearly four decades and hand-ground chuck burgers whose recipe has not changed since opening day. The brick-walled dining room crowned by a glass atrium seats up to 60 and carries an Ocean Wise seafood certification earned through decades of responsible sourcing, not marketing. It sits a ten-minute walk from the Inner Harbour and is served by multiple bus routes, making it a convenient mid-ride stop in the heart of the city.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 86m; stands (2 spaces) at 87m; stands (2 spaces) at 89m; stands (8 spaces) at 95m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for ferrisoysterbar.com provides strong evidence of an active, long-established full-service restaurant at 536 Yates Street with a confirmed phone (778-767-2266) and email. The menu explicitly tags multiple GF items (Seafood Laksa GF, Steamed Shellfish & Fries GF, GF Bun option) and lists a Sunflower Seed Burger and Falafel as vegetarian options. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site; OSM tags provide no additional amenity data. The OSM name 'Ferris'' is shorter than the full name shown on the website ('Ferris' Burger & Oyster Bar'), and OSM had no phone number on record.
concerns: OSM name 'Ferris'' is a truncation; the full business name displayed on the website is 'Ferris' Burger & Oyster Bar'.
OSM had no phone number on record; 778-767-2266 was sourced from the website and cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Ferris' is a well-established, actively operating full-service restaurant in downtown Victoria with a varied menu well-suited to hungry touring cyclists; unconfirmed bike parking is the only notable gap and warrants a quick field check rather than exclusion.
